title: Watch it back! Webinar on pilot coordinated assessment for medical devices
summary:
[문서 목적] 
본 문서는 의료기기(MDR) 및 체외진단의료기기(IVDR) 임상시험/성능시험에 대한 '조정된 심사 절차(Coordinated Assessment Procedure)' 파일럿 프로그램 참여를 위한 의향서(Expression of Interest) 양식입니다.

[핵심 내용]
* 조정된 심사 절차를 신청하고자 하는 스폰서(또는 대리인)가 연구 및 기기에 대한 기본 정보를 사전에 제출하기 위한 표준 서식입니다.
* 스폰서 정보, 연구 상세 내용(연구 설계, 목표, 대상 등), 기기 정보, 참여 희망 회원국 및 제출 예정 시기를 포함합니다.
* 제출된 정보는 유럽연합의 개인정보보호 규정(Regulation 2018/1725)에 따라 수집, 처리 및 저장됩니다.

[주요 요구사항 또는 변경사항]
* 새로 정해진 요구사항은 없으며, 조정된 심사 절차 파일럿에 참여하려는 스폰서가 본 양식에 따라 해당 연구 정보를 기재하여 제출해야 합니다.

[적용 범위]
* MDR에 따른 임상시험 및 IVDR(제58조 1a, 1b/c, 2항)에 따른 성능시험을 계획 중인 스폰서 또는 법적 대리인에게 적용됩니다.

[Manufacturer obligation]
* 스폰서는 조정된 심사 절차 참여를 위해 정확한 연구 정보와 기기 정보를 본 양식에 기재하여 제공할 의무가 있습니다. 또한, 지정된 연락처(SANTE-CA-CIPS@ec.europa.eu)를 통해 절차 관련 문의를 수행할 수 있습니다.

[시행일 및 일정]
* 원문에서 확인되지 않음.

[확인 필요 사항]
* 본 파일럿 프로그램에 참여 가능한 '회원국 목록(list of available Member States for the pilot coordinated assessment)'을 공식 문서를 통해 추가 확인해야 합니다.
* 본 양식 제출 시 참고해야 할 개인정보 보호 정책(privacy statement)의 세부 내용을 확인해야 합니다.

title: Hematology and Pathology Devices; Reclassification of Immunohistochemistry Test Systems for Use With a Corresponding Approved Oncology Therapeutic Product
summary: FDA는 특정 종양 치료제와 함께 사용되는 면역조직화학(IHC) 검사 시스템(클래스 III)을 클래스 II(특별 관리 대상)로 재분류하는 방안을 제안하며, 이를 위한 새로운 분류 규정 및 특별 관리 기준을 마련하고자 합니다.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is proposing to reclassify immunohistochemistry (IHC) test systems indicated for use with a corresponding approved oncology therapeutic product (product codes MVC, NKF, QQT, NQF, PLS, PKW, QUL, QNH, QZJ, SBL, SER, and SHF), which are postamendments class III devices, from class III (premarket approval) into class II (special controls), subject to premarket notification. FDA is proposing minor revisions to an existing classification regulation and also proposing a new device classification regulation, along with the special controls that FDA believes are necessary to provide a reasonable assurance of safety and effectiveness for these devices.

title: Validation of Certain In Vitro Diagnostic Devices for Emerging Pathogens During a Section 564 Declared Emergency; Guidance for Industry and Food and Drug Administration Staff; Availability
summary: FDA는 공중보건 비상사태 선포 시 신종 병원체에 대한 체외진단기기(IVD)의 검증 권장사항을 담은 최종 지침을 발표했습니다. 이 지침은 긴급사용승인(EUA) 신청 및 관련 정책에 따른 시험 데이터 제출 시 적용되는 권장사항과 템플릿을 포함합니다.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or Agency) is announcing the availability of a final guidance titled "Validation of Certain In Vitro Diagnostic Devices for Emerging Pathogens During a Section 564 Declared Emergency." The guidance describes general recommendations for the validation of in vitro diagnostic devices (IVDs) for emerging pathogens during an applicable declaration of public health emergency (PHE). This guidance and the associated template include the recommendations that apply to test data and information submitted in a pre-Emergency Use Authorization (EUA), an EUA request, or to a test offered as described in an applicable enforcement discretion policy.

title: Color Additive Petition From the International Association of Color Manufacturers; Request To Amend the Color Additive Regulations To Remove the Solvents Methylene Chloride, Trichloroethylene, and Ethylene Dichloride
summary: FDA는 아나토 추출물, 파프리카 올레오레진, 강황 올레오레진의 추출 용매 목록에서 메틸렌 클로라이드, 트리클로로에틸렌, 에틸렌 디클로라이드의 사용을 영구적으로 중단함에 따라 관련 규정을 개정하여 승인된 용도를 삭제했습니다. 또한 과일 및 채소 마킹용 잉크 내 메틸렌 클로라이드 사용 승인은 이미 별도의 청원을 통해 삭제되었으므로 해당 부분에 대한 청원은 기각되었습니다.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or we) is partially granting a color additive petition submitted by the International Association of Color Manufacturers (IACM or petitioner), by amending our color additive regulations, on the basis of abandonment, to remove the authorized uses of methylene chloride, trichloroethylene, and ethylene dichloride from the list of authorized extraction solvents for annatto extract, paprika oleoresin, and turmeric oleoresin. The petitioner provided data demonstrating that these uses have been permanently abandoned. FDA is denying as moot the portion of the petition proposing that the color additive regulations be amended, on the basis of abandonment, to no longer authorize the use of methylene chloride as a diluent in color additive mixtures in inks for marking fruit and vegetables. This request is moot because the authorization for this use has been removed, on the basis of the Delaney Clause, in response to a separate petition.

title: Color Additive Petition From Environmental Defense Fund et al.; Request To Amend the Color Additive Regulations To Remove the Solvents Ethylene Dichloride, Methylene Chloride, and Trichloroethylene
summary: FDA는 델라니 조항에 근거하여 과일 및 채소 마킹용 잉크 내 색소 혼합물의 희석제로 사용되는 염화메틸렌의 사용 승인을 취소하는 색소 첨가물 규정 개정안을 최종 승인했습니다. 반면, 아나토 추출물, 파프리카 올레오레진, 강황 올레오레진의 추출 용매로 사용되는 에틸렌 디클로라이드, 염화메틸렌, 트리클로로에틸렌의 사용 승인 취소 요청은 해당 용매 잔류물이 색소 첨가물의 불순물로 간주되어 델라니 조항 적용 대상이 아니라는 이유로 기각했습니다.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or we) is partially granting a color additive petition submitted by Environmental Defense Fund et al. (petitioners), by amending our color additive regulations, on the basis of the Delaney Clause, to remove the authorized use of methylene chloride as a diluent in color additive mixtures in inks for marking fruit and vegetables. The petitioners provided data demonstrating that this additive induces cancer in laboratory animals. We are denying the remaining petition requests to remove ethylene dichloride, methylene chloride, and trichloroethylene from the list of authorized extraction solvents for annatto extract, paprika oleoresin, and turmeric oleoresin, because any residue of the solvent would be an impurity in the color additive and such impurities are not subject to the Delaney Clause.

title: New MDCG 2026-6 Position Paper: Clinical evidence for orphan in vitro diagnostic medical devices
summary: IVDR에 따른 희귀 체외진단기기의 임상 근거에 관한 지침이다. 검체 부족으로 임상 성능자료를 확보하기 어려운 상황에서 일정한 자료의 한계를 허용할 수 있지만, 안전성과 성능을 입증할 충분한 임상 근거가 필요하다고 설명한다. 제조업체·의료기관의 임상 근거와 시판 후 자료 생성, 인증기관 및 전문가 패널의 절차를 다룬다.

gap_analysis.diff_html: 신규 제정·발표 문서이므로 Gap 분석을 수행하지 않습니다. 공식 원문에서 직접 확인하세요.

summary_source.text: The IVD Regulation (IVDR, Regulation (EU) 2017/746) requires that the level of clinical evidence for an IVD is sufficient to demonstrate its performance and safety before being placed on the market. This may present a challenge for IVDs that are specifically intended for use in rare diseases/conditions (e.g. a genetic test for a rare disease) or circumstances (e.g. a toxicological test for an uncommon intoxication). Such IVDs are termed ‘orphan IVDs’ in this guidance and the criteria that they should meet in order to qualify as orphan IVDs are provided. The necessary clinical evidence for an IVD should be based on a sufficient amount and quality of data in order to allow a qualified assessment of its safety, performance, and the intended clinical benefit(s). IVD performance is demonstrated by substantiating scientific validity, analytical performance, and clinical performance. For orphan IVDs, which by their nature address very small patient populations, generating clinical performance data within a reasonable timeframe may be challenging due to limited specimen availability. The field of rare disease/condition/circumstance diagnostics evolves rapidly, with technological developments that sit on the edge between research and clinical diagnostics. Additionally, low sales volumes may limit the commercial viability of orphan IVDs on the EU market. It is thus not surprising that many orphan IVDs are manufactured in-house by health institutions. These health institutions may face similar challenges as IVD manufacturers when generating clinical evidence for their in-house orphan IVDs. Given their unique challenges, the application of IVDR requirements to orphan IVDs should be balanced and proportionate, so that clinical evidence requirements are sufficiently met without unduly hindering or delaying the clinical use of these important devices. There are circumstances where it is acceptable for orphan IVDs to be placed on the market, or to be manufactured and used in-house, with limitations in clinical performance data. Without dedicated guidance, manufacturers, notified bodies, health institutions and regulators may interpret the clinical evidence requirements differently for these IVDs. Some IVDs may have both ‘orphan’ and ‘non-orphan’ indications. Where sufficient clinical evidence for the orphan indication is difficult to demonstrate, the principles in this guidance may be applied to support the orphan indication only. This guidance is divided into two main parts: PART A – Clinical evidence considerations (applicable to both manufacturers and health institutions): - The acceptability of limitations in pre-market clinical performance data for orphan IVDs - Key considerations on the evaluation of clinical performance of orphan IVDs - Generating post-market clinical performance data for orphan IVDs PART B – Procedural considerations (not applicable to health institutions): - Guidance for notified bodies on the assessment of orphan IVDs - The role of the expert panels in the context of orphan IVDs

title: New revision of the MDCG Position Paper on the management of SS(C)P in Eudamed after mandatory use
summary: MDCG 2026-4 rev.1은 EUDAMED의 SS(C)P 업로드를 인증기관에서 제조업체로 전환하는 계획을 설명한다. 새 기능이 운영환경에 완전히 제공되기 전까지 인증기관은 신규 인증서 및 업데이트 등록 시 번역본을 제외한 원본을 업로드한다. 의무사용 전에 출시된 기기의 경우 제조업체가 SS(C)P를 가능한 한 빨리, 늦어도 2027년 3월 27일까지 업로드하도록 안내한다. 이는 MDCG 입장문의 안내이며 법적 의무기한으로 단정하지 않는다.

1. Current situation in EUDAMED: The summary of safety and clinical performance and the summary of safety and performance (SSCP and SSP respectively), are to be uploaded by the notified body during the process of registering certificates information according to Article 32(1) MDR and Article 29(1) IVDR. This policy is however evolving, as described below. 2. Revision of the guidance MDCG 2019-9 – rev.1 on SSCP: Guidance MDCG 2019-9 – rev.1 is being revised to assign to the manufacturer the task to upload the SSCPs in EUDAMED, both the ‘master’ version along with the translations1 in accordance with Article 29(4) MDR. It is the responsibility of the manufacturer to ensure that the uploaded SSCP is the one validated by the notified body during the certification process. The changes outlined in the revised guidance will be reflected in EUDAMED and will require the notified body to indicate which is the validated SSCP(s), or parts thereof, in accordance with Article 32(1) MDR, by ticking the box(es) corresponding to the relevant Basic UDI-DI(s). This functionality will be available when registering and/or linking the relevant certificate. See the guidance for more details. This procedure will apply as well to SSP (IVDs). 3. Timeline for implementation in EUDAMED: Changes will be implemented in EUDAMED in the coming months and after the mandatory use date. A transitional period will be foreseen to switch the task of SS(C)P upload in EUDAMED from the notified body to the manufacturer. In practice, from 28th May 2026 (date of mandatory use of the first four modules of EUDAMED) and until the new functionalities described in paragraph 2 are fully available in the EUDAMED Production environment, notified bodies need to upload SS(C)Ps alongside the registration of new certificates, including their updates, for concerned devices. The upload concerns only the master SS(C)Ps, without the translations. Management of translations will be done by the manufacturer in line with MDCG 2021-1 rev.1 and MDCG 2022-12 respectively.
Therefore, manufacturers should upload SS(C)Ps in EUDAMED as soon as possible, and no later than 27 March 2027 for devices placed on the market before mandatory use considering that manufacturers and notified bodies should align on timelines to fulfil their registration obligations.

title: Essential Drug Delivery Performance Characteristics for Devices Intended To Deliver Drugs and Biological Products; Revised Draft Guidance for Industry; Availability
summary: FDA는 의약품 및 생물학적 제제 전달용 기기의 필수 성능 특성에 관한 개정 가이던스 초안을 공개했다. 2024년 7월 1일 공개된 기존 초안을 대체한다. 기기 구성요소가 포함된 복합제품을 포함해 약물 전달 성능 정보와 데이터의 개발·구성에 관한 권고를 제공한다.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or Agency) is announcing the availability of a revised draft guidance for industry entitled "Essential Drug Delivery Performance Characteristics for Devices Intended to Deliver Drugs and Biological Products." This revised draft guidance revises and replaces the draft guidance entitled "Essential Drug Delivery Outputs Intended to Deliver Drugs and Biological Products" announced in the Federal Register on July 1, 2024 (89 FR 54470). In accordance with its mission of protecting, promoting, and advancing public health, this guidance addresses key aspects of drug delivery performance information for devices, and combination products that include device constituent parts, intended for delivery of a human drug, including a biological product (herein referred to as drug delivery devices). This guidance provides recommendations for development and organization of device drug-delivery performance information and data to improve the consistency of this information in applications and to facilitate transparency and predictability in development and regulatory review. The guidance is intended to facilitate and streamline development and lifecycle management of drug delivery devices.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or Agency) is announcing the availability of the draft guidance titled "Electronic Submission Template for Investigational Device Exemption (IDE) Applications." FDA is issuing this draft guidance for sponsors submitting IDE applications to the Center for Devices and Radiological Health (CDRH) and Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research (CBER). It introduces those sponsors to the current publicly available resources and associated content developed to support IDE electronic submissions to FDA. This draft guidance, when finalized, is intended to represent one of several steps in meeting FDA's commitment to the development of electronic submission templates to serve as guided submission preparation tools for sponsors to improve submission consistency and enhance efficiency in the review process. This draft guidance is not final nor is it for implementation at this time.

gap_analysis.past_text: EN   EN EUROPEAN COMMISSION Brussels, 2.10.2026 C(2026) 7113 final COMMISSION IMPLEMENTING DECISION of 2.10.2026 on the selection of medical devices for joint clinical assessment at Union level (Only the English text is authentic) (Text with EEA relevance) EN 1  EN COMMISSION IMPLEMENTING DECISION of 2.10.2026 on the selection of medical devices for joint clinical assessment at Union level (Only the English text is authentic) (Text with EEA relevance) THE EUROPEAN COMMISSION, Having regard to the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, Having regard to Regulation (EU)  2021/2282 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 15 December 2021 on health technology assessment and amend ing Directive 2011/24/EU1, and in particular Article 7(4) thereof, Whereas: (1) Pursuant to Article  7(4) of Regulation (EU)  2021/2282, after seeking a recommendation from the Member State Coordination Group on Health Technology Assessment established under Article 3 of that Regulation (‘the Coordination Group’), the Commission is to adopt a decision, by means of an implementing act, at least every two years, selecting medical devices and  in vitro diagnostic medical devices  for joint clinical assessment. Th e Commission is to select those devices from the medical devices for which the relevant expert panels, designated pursuant to Article  106(1) of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 of the European Parliament and of the Council2 (‘the expert panels’) have provided a scientific opinion or their views. (2) Pursuant to Article 3(2) of Commission Implementing Regulation (EU)  2024/26993, the European Medicines Agency is to provide, no later than 15  days after the end of the quarter concerned, the Commission acting as secretariat of the Coordination Group (‘the HTA secretariat’) with information on all medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices for which the expert panels provided a scientific opinion or their views in the  framework of the clinical evaluation consultation procedure (‘CECP’) pursuant to Article 54 of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 or the performance evaluation consultation procedure pursuant to Article 48(6) of Regulation (EU) 2017/746 of the 1 OJ L 458, 22.12.2021, p. 1, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2021/2282/oj. 2 Regulation (EU) 2017/745 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 5  April 2017 on medical devices, amending Directive  2001/83/EC, Regulation (EC)  No 178/2002 and Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009 and repealing Council Directives  90/385/EEC and 93/42/EEC (OJ L 117, 5.5.2017, p. 1, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2017/745/oj). 3 Commission Imple menting Regulation (EU)  2024/2699 of 18  October 2024 laying down, pursuant to Regulation (EU)  2021/2282 of the European Parliament and of the Council, detailed procedural rules for the cooperation of the Member State Coordination Group on Health Technology  Assessment and the Commission with the European Medicines Agency in the form of exchange of information as regards the joint clinical assessment of medicinal products and medical devices and  in vitro diagnostic medical devices and as regards the joint sci entific consultation on medicinal products and medical devices ( OJ L, 2024/2699, 21.10.2024, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2024/2699/oj). EN 2  EN European Parliament and of the Council 4. For the first reporting period, the European Medicines Agency was to provide that information covering the period from 1 January 2024. (3) Pursuant to Article 4(2) of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2699, t he HTA secretariat is to make that information available to the Coordination Group’s subgroup on joint clinical assessments (‘the JCA Subgroup’) for further analysis in the preparation of the recommendation referred to in Article 7(4) of Regulation (EU) 2021/2282. (4) On 15  April 2025, 15 July 2025, 15  October 2025, 15  January 2026 and 17 April 2026, the European Medicines Agency provided the HTA secretariat with information on all medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices for which the expert panels provided a scientif ic opinion or their views during the period from 1 January 2024 to 31  March 2026. The HTA secretariat made that information available to the JCA Subgroup for further analysis in the preparation of the recommendation referred to in Article 7(4) of Regulation (EU) 2021/2282. (5) Based on the analysis of the JCA Subgroup, on 22  June 2026, the Coordination Group recommended that the Commission select for joint clinical assessment the medical devices under the names SAPIEN M3 TRANSCATHETER MITRAL VALVE REPLACEMENT SYSTEM  with CECP dossier No EMA/EX/0000242967 and HIGHLIFE TRANS -SEPTAL MITRAL VALVE REPLACEMENT SYSTEM  with CECP dossier No EMA/EX/0000309556. (6) The medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices are to be selected for joint clinical assessment based on one or more of the criteria listed in points (a) to (f) of Article 7(4) of Regulation (EU) 2021/2282, namely, unmet medical needs, first in class, potential impact on patients, public health or healthcare systems, incorporation of software usi ng artificial intelligence, machine learning technologies or algorithms, significant cross-border dimension and major Union-wide added value. (7) Both medical devices recommended by the Coordination Group comply with  the criteria listed in Article 7(4), po ints (a), (b), (c), (e) and (f), of Regulation (EU) 2021/2282. (8) In particular, the medical device under the name SAPIEN M3 TRANSCATHETER MITRAL VALVE REPLACEMENT SYSTEM addresses an unmet medical need for the treatment of symptomatic moderate -to-severe or severe mitral regurgitation in patients who are deemed by a heart team unsuitable for surgery or transcatheter edge - to-edge therapy. The medical device is first in class, as currently there is no equivalent medical device with the same mechanism of acti on or technological approach available on the market for the same medical indication. That medical device is designed to lead to improvements in patients’ survival, morbidity, and quality of life. Therefore, it could have a potential impact on patients, pu blic health and healthcare systems. Furthermore, the medical device is within the remit of the decision -making bodies for health technology assessment of several Member States that confirmed that a joint clinical assessment of that medical device carried o ut at Union level would add value and achieve its objectives better than a clinical assessment carried out at Member State level. 4 Regulation (EU)  2017/746 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 5  April 2017 on  in vitro diagnostic medical devices and repealing Directive  98/79/EC and Commission Decision 2010/227/EU (OJ L 117, 5.5.2017, p. 176, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2017/746/oj). EN 3  EN (9) On the day that the Coordination Group adopted its recommendation, all certificates of conformity had already been issued for the placing on the market of the medical device under the name SAPIEN M3 TRANSCATHETER MITRAL VALVE REPLACEMENT SYSTEM . There is therefore a risk of potential duplication of clinical assessments taking place both at Union and Member State levels. The medical device is first in class as currently there is no equivalent medical device with the same mechanism of action or technological approach available on the market for the same medical indication. That medical device is designed  to lead to improvements in patients’ survival, morbidity, and quality of life. Therefore, it could have a potential impact on patients, public health and healthcare systems. Furthermore, the medical device is within the remit of the decision -making bodies  for health technology assessment of several Member States that confirmed that a joint clinical assessment of the medical device carried out at Union level would add value and achieve its objectives better than a clinical assessment carried out at Member State level. (11) On the day that the Coordination Group adopted its recommendation, all certificates of conformity had already been issued for the placing on the market  of the medical device under the name HIGHLIFE TRANS -SEPTAL MITRAL VALVE REPLACEMENT SYS TEM. There is therefore a risk of potential duplication of clinical assessments taking place both at Union and Member State levels. However, the Coordination Group explained that that risk was mitigated in the case of that medical device, as only one Membe r State had declared an ongoing assessment at national level of the device, while several other Member States had confirmed that a joint clinical assessment carried out at Union level would add value and achieve its objectives better than the work carried out at the level of that Member State. EN EN EUROPEAN COMMISSION Brussels, 2.10.2026 C(2026) 7113 final COMMISSION IMPLEMENTING DECISION of 2.10.2026 on the selection of medical devices for joint clinical assessment at Union level (Only the English text is authentic) (Text with EEA relevance) EN 1 EN COMMISSION IMPLEMENTING DECISION of 2.10.2026 on the selection of medical devices for joint clinical assessment at Union level (Only the English text is authentic) (Text with EEA relevance) THE EUROPEAN COMMISSION, Having regard to the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, Having regard to Regulation (EU) 2021/2282 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 15 December 2021 on health technology assessment and amend ing Directive 2011/24/EU1, and in particular Article 7(4) thereof, Whereas: (1) Pursuant to Article 7(4) of Regulation (EU) 2021/2282, after seeking a recommendation from the Member State Coordination Group on Health Technology Assessment established under Article 3 of that Regulation (‘the Coordination Group’), the Commission is to adopt a decision, by means of an implementing act, at least every two years, selecting medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices for joint clinical assessment. Th e Commission is to select those devices from the medical devices for which the relevant expert panels, designated pursuant to Article 106(1) of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 of the European Parliament and of the Council2 (‘the expert panels’) have provided a scientific opinion or their views. (2) Pursuant to Article 3(2) of Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/26993, the European Medicines Agency is to provide, no later than 15 days after the end of the quarter concerned, the Commission acting as secretariat of the Coordination Group (‘the HTA secretariat’) with information on all medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices for which the expert panels provided a scientific opinion or their views in the framework of the clinical evaluation consultation procedure (‘CECP’) pursuant to Article 54 of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 or the performance evaluation consultation procedure pursuant to Article 48(6) of Regulation (EU) 2017/746 of the 1 OJ L 458, 22.12.2021, p. 1, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2021/2282/oj. 2 Regulation (EU) 2017/745 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 5 April 2017 on medical devices, amending Directive 2001/83/EC, Regulation (EC) No 178/2002 and Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009 and repealing Council Directives 90/385/EEC and 93/42/EEC (OJ L 117, 5.5.2017, p. 1, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2017/745/oj). 3 Commission Imple menting Regulation (EU) 2024/2699 of 18 October 2024 laying down, pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2021/2282 of the European Parliament and of the Council, detailed procedural rules for the cooperation of the Member State Coordination Group on Health Technology Assessment and the Commission with the European Medicines Agency in the form of exchange of information as regards the joint clinical assessment of medicinal products and medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices and as regards the joint sci entific consultation on medicinal products and medical devices ( OJ L, 2024/2699, 21.10.2024, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2024/2699/oj). EN 2 EN European Parliament and of the Council 4. For the first reporting period, the European Medicines Agency was to provide that information covering the period from 1 January 2024. (3) Pursuant to Article 4(2) of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2699, t he HTA secretariat is to make that information available to the Coordination Group’s subgroup on joint clinical assessments (‘the JCA Subgroup’) for further analysis in the preparation of the recommendation referred to in Article 7(4) of Regulation (EU) 2021/2282. (4) On 15 April 2025, 15 July 2025, 15 October 2025, 15 January 2026 and 17 April 2026, the European Medicines Agency provided the HTA secretariat with information on all medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices for which the expert panels provided a scientif ic opinion or their views during the period from 1 January 2024 to 31 March 2026. The HTA secretariat made that information available to the JCA Subgroup for further analysis in the preparation of the recommendation referred to in Article 7(4) of Regulation (EU) 2021/2282. (5) Based on the analysis of the JCA Subgroup, on 22 June 2026, the Coordination Group recommended that the Commission select for joint clinical assessment the medical devices under the names SAPIEN M3 TRANSCATHETER MITRAL VALVE REPLACEMENT SYSTEM with CECP dossier No EMA/EX/0000242967 and HIGHLIFE TRANS -SEPTAL MITRAL VALVE REPLACEMENT SYSTEM with CECP dossier No EMA/EX/0000309556. (6) The medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices are to be selected for joint clinical assessment based on one or more of the criteria listed in points (a) to (f) of Article 7(4) of Regulation (EU) 2021/2282, namely, unmet medical needs, first in class, potential impact on patients, public health or healthcare systems, incorporation of software usi ng artificial intelligence, machine learning technologies or algorithms, significant cross-border dimension and major Union-wide added value. (7) Both medical devices recommended by the Coordination Group comply with the criteria listed in Article 7(4), po ints (a), (b), (c), (e) and (f), of Regulation (EU) 2021/2282. (8) In particular, the medical device under the name SAPIEN M3 TRANSCATHETER MITRAL VALVE REPLACEMENT SYSTEM addresses an unmet medical need for the treatment of symptomatic moderate -to-severe or severe mitral regurgitation in patients who are deemed by a heart team unsuitable for surgery or transcatheter edge - to-edge therapy. The medical device is first in class, as currently there is no equivalent medical device with the same mechanism of acti on or technological approach available on the market for the same medical indication. That medical device is designed to lead to improvements in patients’ survival, morbidity, and quality of life. Therefore, it could have a potential impact on patients, pu blic health and healthcare systems. Furthermore, the medical device is within the remit of the decision -making bodies for health technology assessment of several Member States that confirmed that a joint clinical assessment of that medical device carried o ut at Union level would add value and achieve its objectives better than a clinical assessment carried out at Member State level. 4 Regulation (EU) 2017/746 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 5 April 2017 on in vitro diagnostic medical devices and repealing Directive 98/79/EC and Commission Decision 2010/227/EU (OJ L 117, 5.5.2017, p. 176, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2017/746/oj). EN 3 EN (9) On the day that the Coordination Group adopted its recommendation, all certificates of conformity had already been issued for the placing on the market of the medical device under the name SAPIEN M3 TRANSCATHETER MITRAL VALVE REPLACEMENT SYSTEM . There is therefore a risk of potential duplication of clinical assessments taking place both at Union and Member State levels. Howev er, the Coordination Group explained that that risk was mitigated in the case of that medical device, as only one Member State had declared an ongoing assessment at national level of that device, while several other Member States had confirmed that a joint clinical assessment carried out at Union level would add value and achieve its objectives better than the work carried out at the level of that Member State. (10) The medical device under the name HIGHLIFE TRANS-SEPTAL MITRAL VALVE REPLACEMENT SYSTEM addresses an unmet medical need for the treatment of moderate-to-severe or severe mitral valve regurgitation due to primary (i.e. degenerative), secondary (i.e. functional) or both primary and secondary mitral valve regurgitation in patients with le ft ventricular ejection fraction ≥ 30 % and left ventricular end-diastolic dimension ≤ 70 mm who do not have severe mitral annular calcification and are deemed by a multi-disciplinary heart team unsuitable for surgical repair/replacement or transcatheter edge-to-edge repair. The medical device is first in class as currently there is no equivalent medical device with the same mechanism of action or technological approach available on the market for the same medical indication. That medical device is designed to lead to improvements in patients’ survival, morbidity, and quality of life. Therefore, it could have a potential impact on patients, public health and healthcare systems. Furthermore, the medical device is within the remit of the decision -making bodies for health technology assessment of several Member States that confirmed that a joint clinical assessment of the medical device carried out at Union level would add value and achieve its objectives better than a clinical assessment carried out at Member State level. (11) On the day that the Coordination Group adopted its recommendation, all certificates of conformity had already been issued for the placing on the market of the medical device under the name HIGHLIFE TRANS -SEPTAL MITRAL VALVE REPLACEMENT SYS TEM. There is therefore a risk of potential duplication of clinical assessments taking place both at Union and Member State levels. However, the Coordination Group explained that that risk was mitigated in the case of that medical device, as only one Membe r State had declared an ongoing assessment at national level of the device, while several other Member States had confirmed that a joint clinical assessment carried out at Union level would add value and achieve its objectives better than the work carried out at the level of that Member State. (12) The recommendation of the Coordination Group aligns with the Commission’s response to cardiovascular health as the Union’s leading public health challenge 5. Specifically, joint clinical assessments of cardiovasc ular medical devices, including cardiac valves, are expected to help Member States make fast and informed decisions on the pricing and reimbursement of those medical devices. 5 See Communication from the Commission of 16 December 2025 to the European Parliament, the Council, the European Economic and Social Committee and the Committee of the Regions on an EU cardiovascular health plan: the Safe Hearts Plan (COM(2025) 1024 final), in particular pillar 3 ‘Living with cardiovascular diseases – improving patient treatment and care’. EN 4 EN (13) It is therefore appropriate to follow the recommendation of the Coordination Group and to select the medical devices under the names SAPIEN M3 TRANSCATHETER MITRAL VALVE REPLACEMENT SYSTEM and HIGHLIFE TRANS -SEPTAL MITRAL VALVE REPLACEMENT SYSTEM for joint clinical assessment. (14) The measures provided for in this Decision are in accordance with the opinion of the Committee on Health Technology Assessment established by Article 33(1) of Regulation (EU) 2021/2282, HAS ADOPTED THIS DECISION: Article 1 The following medical devices are selected for joint clinical assessment at Union level: (a) name of medical device: SAPIEN M3 TRANSCATHETER MITRAL VALVE REPLACEMENT SYSTEM; name of manufacturer: EDWARDS LIFESCIENCES LLC; CECP dossier No: EMA/EX/0000242967; EU technical documentation assessment certificate No: G70 039555 0224 of 11 April 2025; (b) name of medical device: HIGHLIFE TRANS -SEPTAL MITRAL VALVE REPLACEMENT SYSTEM; name of manufacturer: HIGHLIFE SAS; CECP dossier No: EMA/EX/0000309556; EU technical documentation assessment certificate No: 2292597TD01 of 23 January 2026. Article 2 This Decision is addressed to the Member State Coordination Group on Health Technology Assessment. Done at Brussels, 2.10.2026 For the Commission Sandra GALLINA Director-General Directorate-General for Health and Food Safety
HTA Regulation - Commission selects first medical devices for joint clinical assessment

summary_source.text: The Commission has adopted its first decision to select two medical devices for joint clinical assessment under the EU Health Technology Assessment (HTA) Regulation. The two devices are both addressing cardiovascular disease.  One of the selected devices is the SAPIEN M3 Transcatheter Mitral Valve Replacement System, manufactured by Edwards Lifesciences LLC. The assessor and co-assessor for this joint clinical assessment are from the Dutch National Health Care Institute (ZIN) and the Norwegian Medical Products Agency (DMP), respectively.  The other device is the Highlife Trans-septal Mitral Valve Replacement System, manufactured by Highlife SAS. The assessor and a co-assessor for this joint clinical assessment are from the French National Authority for Health (HAS) and the Agency for Health Technology Assessment and Tariff System, Poland (AOTMiT).  The Commission Decision follows the recommendation by the Member State Coordination Group on Health Technology Assessment at its 22 June meeting.  Currently, there are 15 Joint clinical assessments ongoing for medicinal products with 4 published JCA reports. Today marks the beginning of joint work on medical devices under the HTA regulation.  Joint Clinical Assessments allow EU Member States to work together to assess the clinical benefits of new medicines and certain medical devices compared to existing health technologies. Patients and clinical experts are systematically consulted during this process. The outcome is a joint clinical assessment report and summary report. These reports will be used by Member States in their national decision-making procedures.

title: Medical Devices; Exemptions From Premarket Notification: Class II Devices; Certain Clinical Toxicology Test Systems
summary: FDA는 일부 II등급 임상 독성검사 시스템을 일정한 제한 아래 시판 전 신고(510(k))에서 면제하기로 최종 결정했다. 면제는 즉시 효력을 가지며 해당 연방규정의 분류 문구도 수정한다.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is publishing an order setting forth its final determination to exempt certain class II clinical toxicology test systems from premarket notification (510(k)) requirements, subject to certain limitations. This exemption from 510(k) requirements, subject to certain limitations, is immediately in effect for such devices. This exemption will decrease regulatory burdens on the medical device industry and will eliminate private costs and expenditures required to comply with certain Federal regulations. FDA is amending the classification language within the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) for certain class II clinical toxicology test systems to reflect this final determination. FDA is publishing this order in accordance with the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act).

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is classifying the high throughput DNA sequencing for hereditary cancer predisposition assessment test system into class II (special controls). The special controls that apply to the device type are identified in this order and will be part of the codified language for classification of the high throughput DNA sequencing for hereditary cancer predisposition assessment test system. We are taking this action because we have determined that classifying the device into class II will provide a reasonable assurance of the safety and effectiveness of the device. We believe this action will also enhance patients' access to beneficial innovative devices, in part by reducing regulatory burdens.

title: Medical Devices Regulations (SOR/98-282) — 2026-10-01 개정 반영본
summary:
[문서 목적]
이 문서는 캐나다의 의료기기 관리 규정(Medical Devices Regulations)으로, 의료기기의 정의, 분류, 안전성 및 유효성 요건 등 의료기기의 판매, 광고 및 수입과 관련된 법적 기준을 규정합니다.

[핵심 내용]
* 의료기기, 제조업체, 등급, 위해성 등 규제 대상의 법적 정의를 명확히 하여 규정의 적용 범위를 확립함.
* 의료기기의 안전성 및 유효성을 확보하기 위해 위험 식별, 제거, 감소 및 잔류 위험에 대한 정보 제공 의무를 명시함.
* 의료기기를 위해도에 따라 1등급(최저)에서 4등급(최고)으로 분류하며, 복합적인 분류가 가능한 경우 더 높은 등급의 기준을 적용함.
* 의료기기의 설계 및 제조 단계에서 제품 수명 주기 동안 발생 가능한 잠재적 고장 위험을 최소화할 것을 요구함.

[주요 요구사항 또는 변경사항]
* 2026-10-01 개정사항이 반영되었으며, 의료기기의 정의에는 동물용 기기가 제외됨.
* 제조업체는 설계 및 제조 시 위험 관리(식별, 제거, 경감)를 위한 합리적인 조치를 취해야 하며, 특히 잔류 위험에 대한 경고 및 예방 조치를 포함해야 함.
* 기기 판매 시 환자나 사용자의 건강 및 안전에 악영향을 미치지 않아야 하며, 발생 가능한 부작용은 편익 대비 허용 가능한 수준의 위험이어야 함.

[적용 범위]
* 캐나다 내 의료기기의 판매 및 판매를 위한 광고.
* 개인적 사용 목적을 제외한 판매 또는 개인에게 사용하기 위한 의료기기 수입.
* 일부 조항은 조제자(Dispenser)에게 제한적으로 적용되며, 보건 의료 시설에 고정 설치된 의료용 가스 배관 시스템 등은 적용 대상에서 제외됨.

[Manufacturer obligation]
* 제조업체는 제품이 10~20조의 적용 요건을 충족함을 보장해야 함.
* 제조업체는 제품이 해당 요건을 충족한다는 것을 입증하기 위한 객관적 증거(Objective evidence)를 기록·보관해야 함.

[시행일 및 일정]
* 원문에 명시된 규정은 2026-10-01 개정 반영본임(별도의 유예기간이나 전환기한은 본 발췌문에서 확인되지 않음).

[확인 필요 사항]
* 10조~20조의 전체 세부 요건 내용.
* 특정 제품군에 적용되는 별표(Schedule) 목록 및 등급 분류 상세 규칙.
* 조제자(Dispenser)에게 적용되는 26~31조 및 37, 70, 75, 80, 86, 87조의 구체적 의무 사항.

title: MDCG 2026-4 rev.1: MDCG Position Paper: Management of SS(C)P in EUDAMED after mandatory use
summary:
[문서 목적] 
본 문서는 EUDAMED의 의무 사용이 시작됨에 따라, 안전 및 임상 성능 요약서(SSCP)와 안전 및 성능 요약서(SSP)를 EUDAMED에 업로드하는 주체를 인증기관에서 제조업체로 전환하는 절차와 운영 방안을 제시합니다.

[핵심 내용] 
*   기존 인증기관이 수행하던 SS(C)P 업로드 업무가 제조업체의 책임으로 변경됩니다.
*   제조업체는 인증기관이 검증(validate)한 버전의 SS(C)P와 관련 번역본을 직접 EUDAMED에 업로드해야 합니다.
*   인증기관은 EUDAMED 내에서 해당 기기의 Basic UDI-DI와 연계하여, 무엇이 검증된 SS(C)P인지 표시하는 확인 절차를 수행합니다.

[주요 요구사항 또는 변경사항] 
*   **업로드 주체 변경:** 기존 인증기관 중심에서 제조업체 직접 업로드 방식으로 변경됩니다.
*   **시스템 기능 구현:** EUDAMED 내에서 제조업체가 업로드하고, 인증기관이 검증된 버전을 지정(체크박스 확인)할 수 있는 기능이 도입됩니다.
*   **데이터 범위:** 제조업체는 ‘마스터’ 버전과 번역본을 모두 관리하며, 인증기관은 마스터 SS(C)P의 검증 여부 확인에 집중합니다.

[적용 범위] 
*   **규정:** MDR(EU) 2017/745 Article 29 및 32, IVDR Article 29.
*   **대상 제품:** SSCP 대상 기기(MDR) 및 SSP 대상 기기(IVDR).
*   **대상자:** 의료기기 제조업체 및 인증기관(Notified Body).

[Manufacturer obligation] 
제조업체는 인증기관에 의해 검증된 최종 버전의 SS(C)P를 EUDAMED에 업로드할 법적 책임이 있습니다. 또한, 관련 번역본을 포함한 문서화 및 기록 관리를 수행해야 하며, EUDAMED의 새로운 기능이 활성화되는 즉시 또는 지정된 기한 내에 SS(C)P를 업로드하여 규정 준수 상태를 유지해야 합니다.

[시행일 및 일정] 
*   **EUDAMED Playground 환경 도입:** 2026년 7월 예정.
*   **EUDAMED Production(실제 운영) 환경 도입:** 2026년 12월 예정.
*   **기존 출시 제품 업로드 기한:** 의무 사용 이전에 시장에 출시된 제품은 2027년 3월 27일까지 제조업체가 직접 업로드를 완료해야 함.
*   **과도기:** 2026년 5월 28일부터 새로운 기능이 완전히 가동되기 전까지는 기존 방식(인증기관이 마스터만 업로드)이 유지됨.

[확인 필요 사항] 
*   개정 예정인 'MDCG 2019-9 rev.1' 지침의 상세 내용(SS(C)P 관리 절차의 구체적 기술사항).
*   MDCG 2021-1 rev.1 및 MDCG 2022-12의 번역본 관리 지침 상세 사항.
*   인증기관과 제조업체 간의 데이터 연계 시 발생하는 등록 시차에 따른 구체적 조정 협의 프로세스.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is classifying the flushing and storage solution for vascular autografts at room temperature into class II (special controls). We believe this action will also enhance patients' access to beneficial innovative devices, in part by reducing regulatory burdens.

title: Nonclinical Testing Terminology
summary: FDA는 일부 안전 및 보고 규정에서 동물 시험·연구를 비임상 시험·연구로 바꾸고 해당 용어의 정의를 추가하는 직접 최종규칙을 발행했다. 용어 일관성을 위해 전임상과 시험관 내 표현도 비임상으로 바꾸며, 새로운 요건은 추가하지 않는다.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA, Agency, or we) is issuing a direct final rule that substitutes references to "animal" tests or studies with "nonclinical" tests or studies, adds a definition of the terms "nonclinical test" and "nonclinical study," and makes other comparable or conforming amendments in certain safety and reporting sections of its regulations. The direct final rule also substitutes "nonclinical" for "preclinical" and "in vitro" for consistency in terminology. The Agency is issuing these amendments directly as a final rule because we believe they are noncontroversial changes in terminology that are not expected to affect industry practice and FDA anticipates no significant adverse comments. These amendments align with recent amendments to the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act) and the Public Health Service Act (PHS Act) and are intended to remove an emphasis, in certain places, on the use of animal testing as the only scientific methodology to assess the safety of a drug in the nonclinical setting. These changes may also foster the development and use of scientifically valid new testing methodologies, potentially improving predictive accuracy of product safety testing while replacing, reducing, or refining animal use. The rule adds no new requirements.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA, Agency, or we) is proposing to substitute references to "animal" tests or studies with "nonclinical" tests or studies, add a definition of the terms "nonclinical test" and "nonclinical study," and make other comparable or conforming amendments in certain safety and reporting sections of its regulations. The proposed rule would also substitute "nonclinical" for "preclinical" and "in vitro" for consistency in terminology. These proposed amendments align with recent amendments to the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act) and the Public Health Service Act (PHS Act) and are intended to remove an emphasis, in certain places, on the use of animal testing as the only scientific methodology to assess the safety of a drug in the nonclinical setting. These changes may also foster the development and use of scientifically valid new testing methodologies, potentially improving predictive accuracy of product safety testing while replacing, reducing, or refining animal use. The proposed rule would add no new requirements.

title: 체외진단의료기기법 시행규칙 일부개정령(총리령 제2155호, 2026. 9. 18.) 공포 알림
summary:
[문서 목적]
이 문서는 체외진단의료기기 제조업 및 수입업 허가 절차의 효율성을 제고하고, 개인용혈당검사지의 기재 사항을 강화하며, 관련 수수료 체계를 정비하기 위해 발행되었습니다.

[핵심 내용]
* 의료기기통합정보시스템을 통해 품질책임자 자격 확인이 가능한 경우, 허가 신청 시 관련 증빙 서류 제출이 면제됩니다.
* 개인용혈당검사지의 용기 또는 외장에 사용기한과 개봉 후 사용기간을 기재해야 합니다.
* 체외진단의료기기 허가 등에 대한 수수료 규정이 명확해지며, 소상공인 및 중소기업에 대한 수수료 감경 근거가 마련되었습니다.

[주요 요구사항 또는 변경사항]
* 대상자: 체외진단의료기기 제조업자 및 수입업자
* 변경사항: 품질책임자 자격 확인 서류 제출 면제, 개인용혈당검사지 기재 사항 추가, 수수료 산정 기준 명확화 및 감경 대상자 신설

[적용 범위]
* 적용 규정: 체외진단의료기기법 시행규칙
* 제품군: 체외진단의료기기 일반 및 개인용혈당검사지
* 경제운영자: 체외진단의료기기 제조업자, 수입업자, 소상공인 및 중소기업자

[Manufacturer obligation]
* 제조업체는 허가 또는 변경허가 신청 시 품질책임자 자격 확인 서류 제출 의무가 특정 조건하에 면제됩니다.
* 개인용혈당검사지 제조업체는 용기나 외장에 반드시 사용기한 및 개봉 후 사용기간을 표기해야 하는 의무가 신설되었습니다.

[시행일 및 일정]
* 원문에서 확인되지 않음

[확인 필요 사항]
* 수수료 감경의 구체적인 대상 범위 및 감경 비율(금액)
* 본 개정령의 실제 적용 시작일(시행일)
* 기존에 이미 유통 중인 개인용혈당검사지에 대한 경과 조치 여부

⚠ 법 원문 전체가 교체되는 문서입니다 — 아래 Gap 분석을 반드시 확인하세요.

summary: FDA는 CDRH와 CBER에 일부 의료기기 시판 전 승인신청(PMA)을 제출하는 이들을 위해 PMA 및 보완신청 전자 제출 관련 공개 자료를 소개하는 지침 초안을 공개했다. 확정된 지침이 아니며 현재 시행하기 위한 문서가 아니다.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or Agency) is announcing the availability of the draft guidance entitled "Electronic Submission Template for Medical Device Premarket Approval Applications (PMAs)." FDA is issuing this draft guidance for submitters of certain PMAs to the Center for Devices and Radiological Health (CDRH) and Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research (CBER). It introduces those submitters to the current publicly available resources and associated content developed to support electronic submissions of certain PMAs and PMA supplements to FDA. This draft guidance, when finalized, is intended to represent one of several steps in meeting FDA's commitment to the development of electronic submission templates to serve as guided submission preparation tools for industry to improve submission consistency and enhance efficiency in the review process. This draft guidance is not final nor is it for implementation at this time.

title: Medical Devices; Exemption From Premarket Notification: Radiology Computer-Aided Detection and/or Diagnosis Devices and Computer-Aided Triage and Notification Devices
summary: FDA는 청원서에 기술된 조건을 충족하는 경우 암 의심 병변의 방사선 컴퓨터 보조 진단 소프트웨어, 의료영상 분석기, 방사선 컴퓨터 보조 분류·통지 소프트웨어, 방사선 컴퓨터 보조 검출·진단 소프트웨어의 시판 전 신고를 면제해 달라는 청원을 2026년 4월 1일 거부했다. 이 명령은 그 최종 결정을 공표한다.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is publishing an order setting forth its final determination regarding a partial exemption from the premarket notification requirements for radiology computer- aided detection and/or diagnosis devices and computer-aided triage and notification devices that was the subject of a notice published in the Federal Register of December 29, 2025. That notice announced FDA's receipt of a petition that requested exemption from the premarket notification requirements for the following generic device types when certain conditions described in the petition were met: radiological computer-assisted diagnostic software for lesions suspicious of cancer; medical image analyzers; radiological computer aided triage and notification software; and radiological computer-assisted detection and diagnosis software. FDA denied the petition in a response issued to the petitioner on April 1, 2026. FDA is publishing this order in accordance with procedures established by the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act).

title: Recommendations for the Development of Blood Collection, Processing, and Storage Systems for the Manufacture of Blood Components Using the Buffy Coat Method; Guidance for Industry; Availability
summary: FDA는 연막층법으로 수혈용 혈액과 혈액 성분을 제조하기 위한 혈액 채취·처리·보관 시스템의 개발 및 해당 제품의 FDA 제출자료에 관한 제조업체 대상 최종 지침을 공개했다.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or Agency) is announcing the availability of a final guidance titled "Recommendations for the Development of Blood Collection, Processing, and Storage Systems for the Manufacture of Blood Components Using the Buffy Coat Method." The guidance document provides recommendations on the development of blood collection, processing, and storage systems (e.g., blood bags with anticoagulant and additive solutions, empty bags for platelet pooling) intended for the manufacture of blood and blood components for transfusion using the buffy coat (BC) method and on regulatory submissions to FDA for such products. This guidance is intended for manufacturers of blood collection, processing, and storage systems. The guidance announced in this notice finalizes the draft guidance of the same title dated October 18, 2024.

title: MDCG 2020-16 rev.5: Guidance on Classification Rules for in vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices under Regulation (EU) 2017/746
summary:
[문서 목적]
이 문서는 체외진단의료기기(IVD)를 시장에 출시하거나 사용하기 전, 제조사·인증기관·의료기관이 해당 제품의 등급을 적절히 분류할 수 있도록 체외진단의료기기 규정(IVDR, EU 2017/746) 부속서 VIII에 명시된 분류 규칙에 대한 지침을 제공하는 데 목적이 있습니다.

[핵심 내용]
*   체외진단의료기기의 등급 분류를 위한 정의(기기, 표본, 모니터링, 스크리닝 등)를 명확히 제시합니다.
*   의도된 목적(Intended purpose)을 기반으로 한 등급 분류 원칙과 각 규칙(Rule 1~7)별 상세 설명 및 사례를 제공합니다.
*   분류 규칙의 일관된 적용을 위해 보충적인 기술적 판단 기준(기술, 표본, 소프트웨어 등)을 정의합니다.
*   동반진단(CDx) 식별을 위한 흐름도와 복합 사용되는 IVD 분류 사례를 부속서로 포함하고 있습니다.

[주요 요구사항 또는 변경사항]
*   이전 버전(rev.4) 대비 Rule 7의 근거와 예시가 수정/보완되었습니다.
*   기존 규칙 내 정의된 용어(예: 'kit'의 정의)와 예시들이 최신 규정 취지에 맞춰 업데이트되었습니다.
*   대상이 되는 기기: EU 시장 내에서 유통되거나 사용되는 모든 체외진단의료기기.

[적용 범위]
*   적용 규정: 체외진단의료기기 규정(Regulation (EU) 2017/746).
*   적용 대상: 유럽 내 시장에 제품을 출시하거나 서비스를 제공하는 제조사, 인증기관(Notified Bodies), 보건기관.

[Manufacturer obligation]
*   제조업체는 제품을 시장에 출시하기 전, 본 지침을 참조하여 IVDR 규정에 따른 적절한 등급을 분류하고 문서화해야 할 의무가 있습니다.
*   원문에서 확인되지 않음(제조사 기록 보관 기간이나 문서화 서식에 대한 구체적 절차 명시 없음).

[시행일 및 일정]
*   문서 표지에 'September 2026'이 명시되어 있으나, 이것이 해당 지침의 시행일인지 혹은 다음 개정 예정일인지는 본 문서만으로는 확정할 수 없습니다.
*   유예기간 및 전환기한: 원문에서 확인되지 않음.

[확인 필요 사항]
*   표지상의 'September 2026'이라는 날짜가 의미하는 바(발행일 혹은 차기 개정 예정일 여부).
*   이 지침은 법적 구속력을 갖지 않으며, 최종적인 법적 해석은 유럽연합 사법재판소의 권한임을 유의해야 합니다.
*   본 지침은 IVDR 원문과 함께 읽어야 하며, 특정 제품의 등급 분류에 관한 공식적인 판단은 회원국 요청 등에 의한 별도의 시행법령(Implementing acts)이 우선할 수 있습니다.

title: 「의료기기 시판 후 조사에 관한 규정」 일부개정고시(식품의약품안전처고시 제2026-63호, 2026.8.31.)
summary:
[문서 목적]
이 문서는 「의료기기법 시행규칙」 개정에 따라 희소의료기기 등의 시판 후 조사 면제와 관련된 세부 기준을 명확히 규정하여 민원 신청의 예측 가능성을 높이기 위해 발행되었습니다.

[핵심 내용]
* 시판 후 조사 면제 대상 및 세부 절차를 구체화하였습니다.
* 상위 법령(의료기기법 시행규칙)에서 위임된 면제 사항을 본 고시에 반영하여 행정의 일관성을 확보하였습니다.

[주요 요구사항 또는 변경사항]
* 기존에 시행되던 시판 후 조사 제도에서 희소의료기기 등에 대해 면제를 적용할 수 있는 구체적인 근거와 기준이 마련되었습니다.

[적용 범위]
* 대상: 희소의료기기 등 시판 후 조사 면제 대상이 되는 의료기기 및 관련 민원인

[Manufacturer obligation]
* 원문에서 확인되지 않음

[시행일 및 일정]
* 본 고시는 2026년 8월 31일에 공포되었으며, 시판 후 조사 면제와 관련된 상위 법령은 2026년 7월 1일부터 시행되었습니다.

[확인 필요 사항]
* 면제 대상에 해당하는 구체적인 품목군, 면제 신청 시 제출해야 하는 증빙 서류의 종류 및 구체적인 면제 승인 절차는 본 고시의 상세 조항(안 제9조)을 확인해야 합니다.

title: Medical Devices; Classification of Accessories Distinct From Other Devices; Proposed List of Accessories Suitable for Class I; Request for Comments
summary: FDA는 일반관리만으로 안전성과 유효성을 합리적으로 보장할 수 있다고 판단한 부속품을 다른 기기와 별도로 I등급에 분류하도록 제안하고 의견을 요청했다. 이는 최종 결정이 아니다.

summary_source.text: As required by the FDA Reauthorization Act of 2017 (FDARA), the Food and Drug Administration (FDA or Agency) has identified a list of accessories for which the Agency believes general controls alone are sufficient to provide reasonable assurance of safety and effectiveness, making them appropriate for class I classification. FDA is publishing this document proposing to classify these accessories into class I and distinct from other devices, as well as seeking public comment in accordance with procedures established by FDARA. This document does not represent FDA's final determination with respect to the proposed accessories listed in this document.

title: Gastroenterology-Urology Devices; Reclassification of Diagnostic Endoscopic Light Source Systems To Be Renamed Cystoscopic Systems Intended as an Aid for Detection of Bladder Cancer
summary: FDA는 진단용 내시경 광원 시스템(제품코드 OAY)을 III등급에서 시판 전 신고 대상인 II등급(특별관리)으로 재분류할 것을 제안했다. 방광암 검출 보조용 방광경 시스템이라는 명칭의 새 분류 규정과 특별관리도 제안했다.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is proposing to reclassify diagnostic endoscopic light source systems (product code OAY), which are postamendments class III devices, from class III (premarket approval) into class II (special controls), subject to premarket notification. FDA is also proposing a new device classification regulation with the name "Cystoscopic system intended as an aid for detection of bladder cancer," along with special controls that FDA believes are necessary to provide a reasonable assurance of the safety and effectiveness of these devices.

title: Hematology and Pathology Devices; Reclassification of In Situ Hybridization Test Systems for Use With a Corresponding Approved Oncology Therapeutic Product
summary: FDA는 해당 승인 항암 치료제와 함께 사용하도록 지정된 제자리 부합법(ISH) 검사 시스템(제품코드 NYQ, MVD, OWE, PNK)을 III등급에서 시판 전 신고 대상인 II등급(특별관리)으로 재분류하는 최종 명령을 발행했다. 새 분류 규정과 특별관리도 마련한다.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA, the Agency, or we) is issuing a final order reclassifying in situ hybridization (ISH) test systems indicated for use with a corresponding approved oncology therapeutic product (product codes NYQ, MVD, OWE, and PNK), all postamendments class III (premarket approval) devices, into class II (special controls), subject to premarket notification. FDA is also establishing a new device classification regulation, along with the special controls that are necessary to provide a reasonable assurance of safety and effectiveness of this device type.

title: 체외진단의료기기  허가·신고·심사 등에 관한 규정 일부개정 고시
summary:
[문서 목적] 
자가검사용 체외진단의료기기에 대한 ‘사용적합성 자료’ 제출 근거 및 세부 요건을 마련하여, 일반 소비자의 사용 오류를 최소화하고 허가·심사 제도를 합리적으로 운영하기 위해 발행되었습니다.

[핵심 내용]
* 자가검사용 체외진단시약 및 체외진단장비 허가·심사 시 사용적합성 자료 제출이 의무화되었습니다.
* 해당 자료는 전문가가 아닌 일반인이 의도된 목적에 맞춰 정확하게 사용할 수 있는지 검증한 자료여야 합니다.
* 자료 인정 요건으로 식약처 지정기관, 국내·외 전문기관, 또는 품질관리시스템(ISO/IEC 등 규격) 하에서 수행된 시험 결과를 명시하였습니다.
* 제품 모델명 일치가 원칙이며, 다를 경우 이를 입증하는 자료가 필요합니다.

[주요 요구사항 또는 변경사항]
* **신설 사항**: 심사자료 목록에 ‘사용적합성에 관한 자료’가 추가되었으며, 관련 자료의 구체적인 작성 및 인정 기준(일반사항 및 첨부자료 요건)이 제27조에 신설되었습니다.
* **대상**: 자가검사용 체외진단의료기기(시약 및 장비) 제조업체.
* **면제 예외**: 국내에서 허가(인증)된 자가검사용 제품과 외형 및 사용방법이 동등하고, 사용 오류나 위험 발생 가능성이 낮다고 인정되는 경우 사용적합성 자료 제출이 면제될 수 있습니다(별표 7, 8 주석 참조).

[적용 범위]
* 규정: 「체외진단의료기기 허가·신고·심사 등에 관한 규정」
* 제품군: 자가검사용으로 분류되는 체외진단시약 및 체외진단장비.

[Manufacturer obligation]
* 제조업체는 자가검사용 제품의 허가·심사 시 설계가 완료된 제품을 사용하여 수행한 사용적합성 검증 자료를 제출해야 합니다.
* 제출 자료는 식약처 지정 기관, 전문기관 또는 자사 품질관리시스템(ISO/IEC 등) 하에서 관련 규격에 따라 작성되어야 하며, 제품의 모델명 일치 여부를 증명해야 합니다.

[시행일 및 일정]
* 이 고시는 고시한 날(2026년 8월 10일)부터 시행합니다.

[확인 필요 사항]
* 원문에서 확인되지 않음. (기존에 이미 허가받은 제품에 대한 소급 적용 여부, 기 접수된 건에 대한 처리 방침 등 구체적인 경과조치 내용은 본 고시 원문에 명시되어 있지 않음)

title: Radiology Devices; Reclassification of Digital Breast Tomosynthesis System
summary: FDA는 제품 코드 OTE인 디지털 유방 단층영상합성(DBT) 시스템을 시판 전 승인 대상인 3등급에서 시판 전 신고가 필요한 2등급(특별관리)으로 재분류하고, 기기 식별과 안전성·유효성의 합리적 보증에 필요한 특별관리 사항을 담은 신규 분류 규정을 마련할 것을 제안한다.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is proposing to reclassify digital breast tomosynthesis (DBT) systems, product code OTE, which are postamendments class III devices, from class III (premarket approval) into class II (special controls), subject to premarket notification. FDA is also proposing a new device classification regulation with the name "Digital Breast Tomosynthesis System," to identify these devices along with special controls that FDA believes are necessary to provide a reasonable assurance of the safety and effectiveness of these devices.

title: Medical Devices; Radiology Devices; Classification of the Fludeoxyglucose F18-Guided Radiation Therapy System
summary: FDA는 플루데옥시글루코스 F18 유도 방사선 치료 시스템을 2등급(특별관리)으로 분류한다. 적용 특별관리 사항은 명령에 명시되며 분류 규정에 포함된다.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is classifying the fludeoxyglucose F18-guided radiation therapy system into class II (special controls). The special controls that apply to the device type are identified in this order and will be part of the codified language for classification of the fludeoxyglucose F18-guided radiation therapy system. We are taking this action because we have determined that classifying the device into class II will provide a reasonable assurance of safety and effectiveness of the device. We believe this action will also enhance patients' access to beneficial innovative devices, in part by reducing regulatory burdens.

the updates of the European Medical Device Nomenclature The European Medical Device Nomenclature (EMDN), as established by Article 26 of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 – Medical Device Regulation (MDR) and Article 23 of Regulation (EU) 2017/746 - In Vitro Diagnostic medical devices Regulation (IVDR), will be annually reviewed and updated based on the practical use of the EMDN and feedback from its users. This document lays out the procedures for the annual revision as well as the procedure for ad-hoc requests requiring an expedited review. A) Actors involved MDCG Nomenclature working group The Nomenclature working group (“NOM WG”) is an expert group established under the Medical Device Coordination Group (“MDCG”) per Article 103(7) of the MDR responsible for managing, maintaining and monitoring the use of the EMDN. The NOM WG provides assi stance and advice to the Medical Device Coordination Group (MDCG) on all implementation issues related to the EMDN with the aim of supporting the functioning of the future European database on medical devices (EUDAMED). In particular, the NOM WG provides  relevant advice in matters related to the update and maintenance of the EU nomenclature, which is made available by the Commission, in accordance with Article 26 of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 and Article 23 of Regulation (EU) 2017/746. The NOM WG is compo sed of representatives of Member States' competent authorities who are experts in the particular policy area. The group also includes economic operators, healthcare professionals, notified bodies, hospitals, laboratories, patients and consumers at Union level which are appointed as observers to the working group, as a result of a public call for applications. EMDN-TT The European Medical Device Nomenclature Technical Team (EMDN-TT) is a smaller technical group established under the Nomenclature WG which i s composed of technical experts appointed by  the Italian Consortium 1 instituted for the implementation of project “Supporting the Maintenance of the European Medical Device Nomenclature” with the purpose to assess and review proposals, or to provide draft amendments, which include the definition of new and revisions of existing codes of the EMDN for the MDCG Nomenclature WG’s consideration. 1 Italian Consortium set up for the implementation of SMEMDN project, (HS – g- 22 – 19.02) is composed of the Ministry of Health (MOH) and by Friuli Venezia – Giulia Region (FVG – REG) Medical Devices Medical Device Coordination Group Document  MDCG  2024-2 Rev.1 Page 5 of 7 Users Users of the EMDN include but are not limited to competent authorities, notified bodies, manufacturers, auth orised representatives, importers, distributors, and persons referred to in Art. 22(1,3), trade associations, professional bodies, healthcare professionals, hospitals, laboratories, patients, consumers and the World Health Organization (WHO). B) Procedure for the annual revision of the EMDN The annual revisions of the EMDN will proceed by means of four phases. During each phase, different tasks and objectives are undertaken by different actors. Phase I – Collection of requests (January) Phase I of the proce dure involves the collection of requests from users through the platform for EMDN requests 2. The platform for requests will be available year -long. However, the deadline for submitting requests for processing in that same calendar year is 31 January 20XX. Phase II – Evaluation of the requests and analysis of the practical use (February – July) Phase II of the procedure involves a technical evaluation by the EMDN-TT of the: - requests submitted during Phase I, - requests by the NOM WG, - EMDN usage in EUDAMED (e.g. review of devices registered with multiple codes, review of devices registered with code extension “99”). Following the technical evaluation, a first draft proposal for the update of the EMDN is prepared. This proposal and the list of rejected requests are submitted to the NOM WG for review. Phase III – Validation and endorsement (August – October) Under Phase III of the procedure, the NOM WG reviews the proposal submitted at the end of Phase II and provides feedback on the proposed changes to the EMDN-TT, as necessary. Following the processing of feedback, a final draft is then endorsed by the NOM WG. Phase IV – MDCG endorsement and publication (November – December) Phase IV o f the procedure is the final part of the annual cycle and involves the endorsement of the final draft by the MDCG and publication of the officially endorsed update in EUDAMED and the EMDN browser. After MDCG endorsement, translations are elaborated in all EU languages and are validated by the NOM WG. 2 https://webgate.ec.europa.eu/dyna2/emdn/ Medical Devices Medical Device Coordination Group Document  MDCG  2024-2 Rev.1 Page 6 of 7 Note: the above -described timetable for annual updates may be subject to revision depending on the number of requests received. C) Pilot procedure for the ad -hoc updates of the EMDN requiring an expedited review The general rule remains that all requests must proceed through the annual procedure. For reasons related to established need, only requests submitted by competent authorities and notified bodies qualify under the ad-hoc procedure. Under the ad-hoc update procedure, only new code requests may be submitted. If the new code request results in the need to render obsolete or split other codes, then the request will be redirected to the annual procedure pathway. Information to be submitted by applicants A form must be filled out by the applicant  which can be found on the Commission’s website under ‘Guidance - MDCG endorsed documents and other guidance’. This form will require the following non-exhaustive information: 1 Name of NCA1 / NB 2 2 Indication if the request is needed for the registration in the UDI- DI module of EUDAMED 3 Established need demonstration, justification as to why the request should be assessed under the ad- hoc procedure 4 Justification as to why currently existing codes cannot be utilized 5 Manufacturer’s name and authorised representative (where applicable) 6 Device name or technology name under question 7 Detailed description of the device or technology under question, including its intended purpose; 8 Indication if this is considered a novel device 3 9 Indication if the device has or will undergo an Medical Devices Medical Device Coordination Group Document  MDCG  2024-2 Rev.1 Page 7 of 7 expert panel assessment 10 EMDN Category, Group, and Type where the code could be added 11 Draft term description for the new code 12 Reference to other devices on the market with similar technology, potentially also requiring the use of this new code (where applicable) 13 Additional information (e.g. reference to other nomenclature, if any) Processing of the ad-hoc requests Requests should be submitted to SANTE-EMDN@ec.europa.eu . Following receipt of the completed form, the Commission will circulate the information provided by the applicant to the EMDN -TT for a written consultation. Following assessment of the request, the EMDN-TT will provide feedback to the Commission who in turn will inform the applicant whether the application is eligible for the ad-hoc procedure. If the request is considered ineligible, the user will be informed and their submission will be deferred for an assessment under the annual update procedure. If the request is considered eligible for the ad -hoc procedure, it is further analysed by EMDN-TT and a technical proposal is elaborated and circulated with the NOM-WG for review and endorsement. Following the NOM -WG’s endorsement, the MDCG endorses the final version of the technical proposal. During the annual review procedure, ad -hoc updates will be reflected in the annual EMDN updated version.

Publication of videos from the third EMDN training

summary_source.text: The third training provided an overview of the evolving role of the EMDN, with particular focus on its practical use throughout the device lifecycle. It covered the application of the nomenclature in regulatory activities, practical case studies on EMDN code assignment and annual updates, as well as perspectives from industry, Notified Bodies and regional authorities.

title: Audit Approach – MDSAP AU P0002.011
summary:
[개정 이력 주요 내용: 버전 010 → 011]
• QMS 프로세스의 위험기반 관리 요구사항을 Management task 7에서 task 1로 옮겼다. Task 7은 제품 전 수명주기의 위험관리 감독에 초점을 맞췄다.
• 호주 TGA의 제조업체·스폰서 간 UDI 책임을 명확히 하고, task 6의 초점을 교육에서 역량으로 바꿨다.
• PCCP의 AI 기기 한정 표현을 삭제하고, 사이버보안과 시판 후 피드백 관련 내용을 추가했다.
• 기기 또는 포장 변경 시 새 UDI에 관한 FDA 요구사항을 추가했다. 설계 검토의 적합성 평가 부분에서는 독립 검토자에 관한 기존 FDA 요구사항을 삭제했다.
• Annex 2에서 ‘critical supplier’를 ‘sterilization and laboratory service suppliers’로 바꿨다.
위 내용은 공식 개정 이력의 일부이며 Jina Reader가 추출한 텍스트를 바탕으로 했다.

sections.title: Summary of Changes from Prior Revisions — Jina Reader 제3자 추출 텍스트 (PDF 바이트 미검증)
sections.quote:
Changes from version 010 to 011 

Minor wording clarifications throughout 

Management, task 1 – moved the requirements for a risk-based approach to be applied to the control of the quality management system processes from Management task 7 to this task 

Management, task 5 – clarified Australian (TGA) requirements for UDI responsibilities between manufacturer and sponsor 

Management, task 6 – refocused task from training to competence 

Management, task 7 – refocused task to management oversight of risk management throughout the product lifecycle; moved requirements for a risk-based control of QMS processes to Management, Task 1 

Device Marketing Authorization and Facility Registration, task 3 – revised Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP) to remove specificity for Artificial Intelligence enabled devices 

Measurement, Analysis and Improvement, task 12 – added provisions for device cybersecurity and postmarket feedback 

Design and Development, task 7 – added US FDA requirements for device cybersecurity; added  RDC ANVISA 848/2024: Art. 1 to the requirement for Brazil 

Design and Development, task 12 - added US FDA requirements for device cybersecurity; added new linkage to Measurement, Analysis and Improvement 

Design and Development, task 13 – added US FDA requirements for new UDI when the device or packaging changes 

Design and Development, task 14 – removed the old US FDA requirement for an independent reviewer for design review in the “Assessing Conformity” section 

Production and Service Control – task 1 – added Australian (TGA) requirements for UDI; moved assessing conformity for FDA UDI to the country-specific portion of the task 

Production and Service Control – task 16 – amended Australian (TGA) requirements to incorporate UDI 

Production and Service Control – task 18 – added FDA definition of “life-supporting, life-sustaining” device 

Production and Service Control – task 26 – added provisions for devices with software functions to the “Assessing Conformity” for installation activities 

Purchasing – task 5 – pointed the reader to Management, task 5 where Australian (TGA) UDI responsibilities between manufacturer and sponsor are clarified 

Annex 2 – replaced “critical supplier” with “sterilization and laboratory service suppliers” 164

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is classifying the phase-changing fiducial marker for radiation therapy into class II (special controls). The special controls that apply to the device type are identified in this order and will be part of the codified language for classification of the phase-changing fiducial marker for radiation therapy. We are taking this action because we have determined that classifying the device into class II will provide a reasonable assurance of safety and effectiveness of the device. We believe this action will also enhance patients' access to beneficial innovative devices, in part by reducing regulatory burdens.

summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or we) is issuing an order to repeal the color additive regulation that allows for the use of Orange B for coloring the casings or surfaces of frankfurters and sausages. summary_source.text: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or we) is proposing to issue an order that would repeal the color additive regulation that allows for the use of Citrus Red No. 2 for coloring the skins of mature oranges. Based on certification data, it appears that Citrus Red No. 2 is no longer used for coloring the skins of oranges and has not been certified for use as a color additive in food marketed in the United States since 2020. Because the authorized use of Citrus Red No. 2 appears to have been abandoned, we have tentatively concluded that this color additive regulation is outdated and unnecessary.

title: 「의료기기 기술문서심사기관 지정 및 운영 등에 관한 규정」일부개정고시(2026-53호, 2026.7.21.)
summary:
[문서 목적] 
본 개정고시는 「의료기기법」 및 시행규칙 개정에 따른 기술문서심사기관의 지정 유효기간·갱신 절차를 정비하고, 심사기관에 대한 지도·점검 범위의 합리화 및 심사 품질 제고를 위해 발행되었습니다.

[핵심 내용]
* 기술문서심사기관의 지정 유효기간 및 갱신 절차 마련에 따른 관련 인용 조문과 서식 정비
* 심사기관 대상 정기 지도·점검 범위를 갱신 시 검토하는 지정기준을 제외하고 심사업무 실시 현황 중심으로 조정

sections.title: 주요내용
sections.quote:
가. 기술문서심사기관 지정 유효기간 및 갱신의 세부 절차

「의료기기법」및 같은 법 시행규칙 개정으로 기술문서심사기관의 지정 유효기간 및 갱신에 관한 절차가 마련됨에 따라 인용조문 및 관련 서식을 정비함

기술문서심사기관에 대한 정기 지도·점검의 범위를 갱신 시 검토하는 지정기준을 제외하고 심사업무 실시 현황 중심으로 합리적으로 조정함

다. 기술문서 심사의 품질 향상

기술문서 심사의 전문성 및 품질 제고를 위하여 심사원은 한국의료기기안전정보원에서 실시하는 교육을 받도록 하고, 심사 업무 절차서에 2단계 검토 인력에 관한 사항을 포함하는 것을 명확히 하고자 함

gap_analysis.past_text: The European Commission’s Directorate-General for Health and Food Safety (DG SANTE) - through the European Health and Digital Executive Agency (HaDEA) - has commissioned a “ Study supporting the monitoring of availability of medical devices on the EU market ”. The study started in December 2022 and will be running for 36 months (December 2025). The study has been contracted to a consortium led by the Austrian National Public Health Institute (Gesundheit Österreich GmbH/GÖG), in collaboration with Areté and Civic Consulting. In the context of the study, a dashboard has been developed. The dashboard presents an overview of the data gathered from different stakeholders. In addition, comparable data from previous surveys of notified bodies conducted by the European Commission have been integrated in the dashboard. Within the study a survey was also launched to Manufacturers and Authorised Representatives end of 2023. The results can be found in the presentation . At the end of 2024, a second survey of economic operators was conducted. The results can be found in the presentation . At the end of 2025, a third survey of economic operators was conducted. The results can be found in the presentation . Within the study a survey was also launched with health service providers (including health professionals, health institutions and medical device procurement bodies) in 2024. The results can be found in the presentation .

제시해주신 「의료기기 제조 및 품질관리 관련 기관 지정 등에 관한 규정」(제2026-47호)에 대한 요약입니다.

**[문서 목적]**
본 규정은 의료기기 제조 및 품질관리(GMP) 심사기관과 심사원 교육·훈련기관의 지정·운영 및 관리에 필요한 세부 기준과 절차를 정함으로써, 의료기기 품질관리 심사의 공정성과 전문성을 확보하는 데 목적이 있습니다.

**[핵심 내용]**
*   **품질관리심사기관의 자격 및 요건:** 심사기관은 공정성, 독립성, 객관성을 보장하는 조직구조를 갖추어야 하며, 품질경영시스템을 구축·문서화하고 연 1회 이상의 내부감사와 경영검토를 실시해야 합니다.
*   **심사원의 자격 및 교육:** 심사원 및 선임심사원은 학력, 경력, 자격증 등의 요건을 충족해야 하며, 자격 유지를 위해 정기적인 보수 교육과 현장 심사 실적을 충족해야 합니다.
*   **심사업무 수행 원칙:** 심사기관 및 심사원은 신청자에게 적합인증을 위한 자문 서비스를 제공하거나 특정 자문기관을 알선하는 등 이해상충 행위를 엄격히 금지합니다.
*   **기록 유지:** 심사업무 관련 서류는 일정 기간(명시된 보관 기간 등) 이상 보관해야 하며, 기밀 유지를 위한 절차를 마련해야 합니다.

**[주요 요구사항 또는 변경사항]**
*   **조직 및 관리:** 심사업무의 공정성 확보를 위해 운영책임자 지정 및 이해관계자가 참여하는 조직구조를 갖추어야 합니다.
*   **심사원 임명:** 식약처장이 정한 심사원 교육과정 이수 및 자격 기준을 만족해야 하며, 심사원증을 발급받아야 합니다.
*   **부적합 처리:** 심사 결과에 따른 부적합 사항에 대해 시정조치 유효성 확인 절차를 문서화하여 운영해야 합니다.

**[적용 범위]**
*   **대상:** 의료기기 제조 및 품질관리 심사기관, 심사원 교육·훈련기관, 품질책임자 교육실시기관 및 해당 기관의 심사원과 기술전문가.

**[Manufacturer obligation]**
*   **제조업체(신청자) 의무:** 적합성인정에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 품질관리체계 변경 시 심사기관에 통보해야 합니다. 또한 심사기관이 제시한 지적사항에 대해 경영진의 동의 및 시정조치를 수행해야 합니다.

**[시행일 및 일정]**
*   **시행일:** 2026년 1월 1일 (지정서 등 문서 서식에 기재된 일자 근거)
*   **유예기간/기타:** 원문에서 확인되지 않음.

**[확인 필요 사항]**
*   품질관리심사기관의 심사업무 관련 서류 보관 기간(본문에 '년간'이라고만 표기되어 명확한 숫자 확인 필요).
*   품질관리심사기관 심사 시 적용되는 별도의 세부 심사 기준 및 항목별 배점의 구체적인 가이드라인.
*   각 교육기관의 지정 및 관리와 관련된 구체적인 교육 계획서 제출 서식 및 세부 운영 규칙.

title: 「의료기기 제조 및 품질관리 기준」(제2026-46호)
summary:
[문서 목적]
이 문서는 의료기기(임상시험용 의료기기 포함)를 제조 또는 수입하는 자가 준수해야 할 제조 및 품질관리 기준(GMP)에 관한 세부 사항을 규정합니다. 의료기기법 및 관련 법령에 따라 적합성 인정 및 심사 체계를 정립하여 제품의 품질을 보증하는 것을 목적으로 합니다.

[핵심 내용]
* 의료기기 제조업자 및 수입업자는 품목군별로 3년마다 정기심사를 받아야 하며, 최초/추가/변경 심사 절차를 준수해야 합니다.
* 품질관리심사기관은 신청 서류를 검토하고 필요시 현장조사를 실시하며, 적합 여부를 평가하여 적합인정서를 발급합니다.
* 임상시험용 의료기기 등 일부 품목은 적용 기준의 일부 면제나 심사 완화 규정을 적용받습니다.
* MDSAP 적합인정서 보유, 우수제조소 인정 등의 경우 현장조사를 생략하거나 서류검토만으로 대체하는 등 효율적인 심사 절차를 운용합니다.

[주요 요구사항 또는 변경사항]
* 적합성 인정 심사 대상은 제조/수입 허가 및 인증/신고를 하려는 자, 임상시험용 의료기기 제조/수입자입니다.
* 정기심사는 기존 적합인정서 유효기간 만료일 3개월 전까지 신청해야 합니다.
* 심사 과정에서 중대한 부적합 발생 시 시정조치 계획을 제출하고 이행 결과를 보고해야 하며, 미이행 시 부적합 판정을 받을 수 있습니다.

[적용 범위]
* **규정:** 의료기기법, 의료기기법 시행규칙, 의료기기산업 육성 및 혁신의료기기 지원법 등
* **대상:** 의료기기 제조업자 및 수입업자, 임상시험용 의료기기 제조/수입자
* **제외 대상:** 1등급 의료기기, 수출용 의료기기 등(일부 예외 조항 적용 가능)

[Manufacturer obligation]
* 제조업자는 제조소의 품질매뉴얼, 제품표준서, 시험성적서 등 품질관리에 필요한 문서를 작성하고 보관해야 합니다.
* 적합인정서의 유효기간을 관리하고 정기심사 신청 기한을 준수할 책임이 있습니다.
* 제조소 소재지 변경, 우수제조소 자격 요건 미충족 등 변경 사항 발생 시 10일 이내에 신고하거나 관련 자료를 업데이트해야 합니다.

[시행일 및 일정]
* 제2026-46호 고시는 2026년 7월 1일부터 시행됩니다.
* 개정 규정 시행 전 이미 접수된 심사 건은 종전 규정을 따르는 경과조치가 적용됩니다.

[확인 필요 사항]
* 실제 심사 적용을 위한 상세 기준(별표 1~6, 별지 제1~3호 서식 등)의 구체적인 내용은 공식 원문의 별표 및 별지 첨부 자료를 통해 확인해야 합니다.
* 본 원문에는 2023년 이후의 상세 부칙 내용 중 일부가 끊겨 있어, 개별 조항의 세부 경과조치 및 타 규정과의 연계 사항은 추가 확인이 필요합니다.

title: New MDCG 2026-5 Position Paper: UDI assignment between manufacturers and distributors
summary:
**[문서 목적]**
본 문서는 의료기기 유통업체가 독자적으로 UDI-DI 코드를 발급받아 사용하는 관행으로 인한 혼선을 방지하고, 규제 기관 및 이해관계자들에게 UDI 할당 주체에 대한 명확한 지침을 제공하기 위해 발행되었습니다.

**[핵심 내용]**
*   유통업체가 자신의 브랜드명으로 기기를 판매하더라도, UDI-DI 코드 발급 및 할당의 주체는 반드시 '제조업체'여야 합니다.
*   제조업체는 유통업체와 계약을 통해 실무적인 UDI 할당 업무를 위탁할 수 있으나, UDI 관련 법적 책임은 전적으로 제조업체에 있습니다.
*   유통업체가 자신의 이름으로 UDI-DI를 발급받아 사용하는 것은 규정 위반이며, UDI 발급 기관은 제조사 명의로만 코드를 할당해야 합니다.
*   Eudamed 등록 및 기기 라벨링상의 UDI 관리 권한은 제조업체에 귀속됩니다.

**[주요 요구사항 또는 변경사항]**
*   **UDI-DI 할당 주체 명확화:** 기기가 두 개의 브랜드명으로 판매되어 서로 다른 UDI-DI가 필요한 경우에도, 해당 UDI-DI는 제조사의 명의로 발급되고 관리되어야 합니다.
*   **UDI 발급 기관의 의무:** UDI 발급 기관은 코드 제공 시 해당 코드가 '제조업체'에 연결되도록 보장해야 합니다.
*   **제조업체 대상:** 라벨에 명시된 제조업체만이 Eudamed에 기기를 등록하고, 기기 패키지에 UDI를 부착할 수 있습니다.

**[적용 범위]**
*   **적용 규정:** EU 의료기기 규정 (EU) 2017/745 (MDR) 및 체외진단의료기기 규정 (EU) 2017/746 (IVDR)
*   **대상:** EU 시장 내 의료기기 제조업체, 유통업체, UDI 발급 기관

**[Manufacturer obligation]**
*   **법적 책임:** 제조업체는 UDI 시스템 관련 의무(코드 할당 및 유지, Eudamed 등록 등)에 대해 최종적인 법적 책임을 집니다.
*   **문서화 및 기록:** 제조업체는 제품의 브랜드명이 다르더라도 해당 기기에 부여된 모든 UDI-DI를 자사 명의로 관리하고 Eudamed에 등록해야 할 의무가 있습니다.
*   **위탁 관리:** 제3자(유통업체 등)에게 UDI 할당 실무를 위임할 수 있으나, 이 경우에도 해당 코드는 제조업체의 명의로 발급되어야 합니다.

**[시행일 및 일정]**
*   본 문서는 2026년 7월에 발행되었습니다. (별도의 유예기간 및 전환기한은 원문에 명시되지 않음)

**[확인 필요 사항]**
*   유통업체가 제조사로부터 위임받아 실무를 수행할 때 체결해야 하는 계약의 상세 요건이나 구체적인 위임 절차는 원문에서 확인되지 않음.

title: 「체외진단의료기기 품목 및 품목별 등급에 관한 규정」 고시 전문(제2026-45호, 2026.6.30.)
summary:
본 요약은 「체외진단의료기기 품목 및 품목별 등급에 관한 규정」(고시 제2026-45호) 원문을 근거로 작성되었습니다.

**[문서 목적]**
본 고시는 「체외진단의료기기법」에 따라 체외진단의료기기의 품목 분류 기준과 품목별 등급을 정의하고, 이를 통해 안전성 및 유효성을 확보하기 위해 발행되었습니다.

**[핵심 내용]**
*   **품목 분류 및 등급 체계:** 독립적인 부분품이나 복합 구성 기기의 분류 기준을 명시하며, 제품의 성능과 사용 목적에 따라 품목명과 등급을 별표에 규정함.
*   **자가검사용 기기 기준:** 일반인이 전문가 도움 없이 사용할 수 있도록 검체 채취의 용이성, 사용 편의성, 잠재적 위해성 등을 고려하여 자가검사용 분류 기준을 제시함.
*   **품목 재분류 절차:** 재분류 신청 시 기술문서 및 유사 제품과의 비교 자료 제출 의무와 전문가위원회의 심의를 통한 90일 이내 결정·고지 절차를 규정함.
*   **규제 타당성 검토:** 2020년 7월 1일을 기준으로 매 3년마다 규제의 타당성을 검토하여 개선 조치를 시행함.

**[주요 요구사항 또는 변경사항]**
*   **품목 삭제 및 변경:** 고시 개정을 통해 기구·기계 및 체외진단용 시약 관련 특정 품목들이 삭제되거나 분류가 조정됨.
*   **시행 특례:** ‘K06060.01 자가검사용마약류물질대사검사시약’은 고시 후 2년 뒤 시행하며, 시행 이전이라도 인증 절차를 진행할 수 있는 특례를 마련함.
*   **경과조치:** 기 허가·인증·신고된 품목은 별도의 절차 없이 변경된 분류번호, 품목명, 등급이 적용된 것으로 간주하나, 특정 품목(과거 개정 당시 공고된 건 포함)은 재발급이 요구될 수 있음.

**[적용 범위]**
*   **규정:** 「체외진단의료기기법」 제3조 및 같은 법 시행규칙 제2조
*   **대상:** 체외진단의료기기 제조업자, 수입업자 및 해당 품목 전반

**[Manufacturer obligation]**
*   **문서화 및 기록:** 제조업자는 재분류 신청 시 기술문서, 구조·원리·성능·사용목적 등에 관한 기술적 특성 비교·분석 자료를 제출해야 함.
*   **기재사항 관리:** 품목 분류나 명칭이 변경된 경우, 종전 기재사항이 담긴 용기·포장·첨부문서는 일정 유예기간(통상 1년) 동안만 사용 가능함.

**[시행일 및 일정]**
*   **시행일:** 2026년 6월 30일 (단, 일부 품목은 별도 유예기간 적용)
*   **재검토 기한:** 매 3년 단위의 6월 30일까지 타당성 검토 시행.

**[확인 필요 사항]**
*   **세부 품목 정보:** 별표에 명시된 구체적인 제품별 등급 상세 목록(본 텍스트 원문은 일부 항목이 잘려 있음).
*   **재발급 대상 확인:** 경과조치에 따라 허가증 등을 반드시 재발급받아야 하는 구체적 품목 리스트 및 해당 시점의 관보 확인 필요.

title: 「대한민국약전」 전부개정고시 (제2026-44호, 2026.6.29.)
summary:
**[문서 목적]**
본 문서는 「대한민국약전 제13개정(KP 13)」의 통칙으로, 약전의 정의와 의약품의 적부 판정, 시험 방법, 제제 및 생약의 관리 기준, 용기·포장 규격 등 의약품 품질 관리를 위한 전반적인 원칙과 기준을 규정합니다.

**[핵심 내용]**
*   **적부 판정 기준:** 의약품의 품질 적부는 의약품각조, 통칙, 제제총칙, 일반시험법 규정을 따르며, 생약을 제외한 성상(색 등) 및 저장법의 보존조건은 참고 사항입니다.
*   **시험 및 측정 원칙:** 시험 결과의 정밀도를 위해 소수점 처리, 온도/압력/시간의 허용 범위, 질량 측정(정밀하게/정확하게), 시약 사용 등에 대한 표준 기준을 제시합니다.
*   **제제 및 생약 관리:** 제제는 함량, 무균성, 방출 특성 등을 관리해야 하며, 생약은 기원, 채취, 가공, 보존 과정에서의 위생적 관리와 이물질 제거가 필수적입니다.
*   **용기 및 포장:** 용기는 내용물과 물리적·화학적 상호작용이 없어야 하며, 차광, 밀폐, 기밀, 밀봉 등의 정의에 따른 적절한 보존 환경을 제공해야 합니다.

**[주요 요구사항 또는 변경사항]**
*   **국제 표준 반영:** 화학명은 IUPAC 명명법을 따르고, CAS 등록번호를 병행 기재하며, 물리적 단위는 국제단위계(SI)를 기준으로 합니다.
*   **방사성의약품 특수 규정:** 방사능 표시량, 용기의 방사선 차폐 성능 기준, 방사능 표지 생략 기준(핵종별 수량 기준) 등이 명시되었습니다.
*   **포장 적합성:** 포장 변경 시 보호성, 배합적합성, 안전성, 기능성을 검토해야 하며, 유효기간 동안 품질을 보증할 수 있는 포장 자재 관리 항목을 설정해야 합니다.

**[적용 범위]**
*   **대상:** 대한민국약전에 수재된 의약품(의약외품 제외). 
*   **기관:** 해당 약전을 준수해야 하는 모든 의약품 제조업체 및 관련 기관.

**[Manufacturer obligation]**
*   **문서화 및 기록:** 제조공정 밸리데이션, 공정관리, 품질관리 시험검사에 관한 기록을 유지하여 품질 적합성을 항시 보증해야 합니다.
*   **책임:** 의약품의 품질을 보증하기 위해 개발 단계에서 용기·포장의 적합성을 검토하고, 안정성 시험을 통해 관리 항목의 적절성을 확인해야 합니다. 
*   **준수:** 의약품의 안전 관리를 위해 취급 시 인체 접촉 방지 조치를 취해야 하며, 원료(동물 유래 시 건강한 것) 및 첨가제의 안전성을 확보해야 합니다.

**[시행일 및 일정]**
*   2026년 6월 29일 시행 (고시 제2026-44호).

**[확인 필요 사항]**
*   본 문서는 통칙이며, 구체적인 품목별 규격은 의약품각조를 확인해야 함.
*   생물학적 시험법 등 특정 항목의 세부 변경 사항은 각 제조사의 개별 허가 사항과 대조 필요.
